predictions: Box comments whose lines end in ' *' or ' #' reach 0.3+ on the ' *\n'/' #\n' token; the same text in ordinary ' * ' or '# ' comments stays under 0.12.
short: trailing border star in box comment
notes:
Card: every top example is ' *
' at the end of 'you can redistribute it and/or modify *' in box comments, plus ' #
'. Probe used ordinary leading-star comments, none of which produce the ' *
' token, and all stayed low (max 0.097); tokenizer confirms ' *
' only appears when a line ends with ' *'. Untested trigger form, so low confidence.
